dynamic_mixin_add_class: dynamically mixin a new class to an existing object instance at runtime
dynamic_mixin_with_init: dynamically mixin a class to an object and initialize it with a dictionary of arguments
remove_dynamic_mixin_restore: remove a previously mixed in class and restore the object to its original class
remove_dynamic_mixin_no_callback: remove a mixed in class from an object without calling the object's remove callback method
review_dynamic_mixin_usage: review how dynamic_mixin and remove_dynamic_mixin are used to add and remove mixin classes at runtime
